about:
I'm a Software Developer with 4+ years of experience building scalable web applications — from Design System libraries to full-featured B2B platforms.

My work spans frontend-heavy products using Vue.js, Nuxt.js, React and Next.js, as well as backend integrations with Node.js, C# and .NET. I'm an early adopter of AI-assisted development — I actively use Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Claude to accelerate delivery without compromising quality.

📍 São Paulo, SP — Brazil | Open to remote and international opportunities.
